propositions: Commit subject lines exceeding 50 characters are rejected locally with diagnostic output naming the offending line and its length.
Commit body lines exceeding 72 characters are rejected locally, unless exempted by trailer, tag, fenced-block, indented-literal, table-row, or atomic-token rules.
Gerrit's commit-msg hook is preserved and chained as commit-msg.legacy in migration mode so that conforming commits still receive Change-Id stamping.

Exemption rules match the exact regexes and thresholds: trailers (^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*:\s), tags (^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*=), fenced blocks (^\s*```{3}), indentation (≥4 spaces or tab), table rows (^|), and atomic tokens (containing ://, path separators, or dotted identifiers, with remaining stripped line ≤72 chars).
Git scaffolding (comment lines, --verbose diff after >8 marker) produces no false positives and the checker never mutates the message file.
make hooks target verifies both pre-commit and commit-msg hook files exist post-install and warns (but exits 0) if Change-Id stamping is absent.
